title: Divide and Conquer
summary: Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon must navigate the catacombs and get the cursed ring to a Huntik safehouse before thirty minutes pass or the Organization will manage to take control of the ring for evil purposes. While attempting to escape, Lok finds clues similar to those is in his father's journal.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
Sophie binds the Ring of Arc's curse with a [[Banebound]] spell, but the spell will only last about thirty minutes. The team has to get it to a [[Huntik Foundation]] specialist before the curse can harm anyone else Unfortunately, [[DeFoe]] has called on every [[Suits|Suit]] in Paris to block the exits from the catacombs so that he'll be sure to get the prize! Zhalia provides fake copies of the Ring using her disguise kit, and the group splits up having a ring each. Doing so improves their chances of escaping with the real Ring. While they each make their way, Lok finds a case with some archaeology tools while another locked case that [[Springer]] opens is found to have some kind of map.

Even with all their efforts, one by one, they're all captured. But all four members of Dante's group are revealed to have carried only fake rings. Then, Dante reveals that the real Ring of Arc was given to [[Gareon]], who sneaked out of the catacombs invisibly. DeFoe retreats, and, back at Organization headquarters, the mysterious [[Rassimov]] tells him that [[the Professor]] is furious. DeFoe has beens suspended from his duties and is lucky to have not been "terminated" by the Professor yet. In Defoe's secret laboratory, he swears vengeance on Dante Vale in a fit of rage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*[[Lok]] and [[Cherit]] discover the words "Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité" ("Liberty, Equality, Brotherhood"), France's national motto which found its origins in the French Revolution.
*The episode features a double foreshadowing: 
**While casting [[Banebound]] on the ring, Sophie suffers traumatic visions of past and future events. Those include include a scene of [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] punching her, which would occur in the episode "''[[The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]]''", and a scene of [[Sabriel]]'s death, which would occur in the episode "''[[The Mission]]''".
**Sophie's visions are unknowingly inflicted on her by [[Arc]], the Legendary Titan contained inside the ring, the existence of which will only be discovered in Season 2's episode "''[[The Legendary Titan of Fate]]"''.

full_text:
Paris, France

Lok and the Huntik team have found Joan of Arc's hiding place and follow her notes to find the powerful Ring of the Arc. The Professor, evil leader of the Organization, is on their trail, thanks to DeFoe, his henchman. A race against the clock to find the ring starts. The Huntik team wins but they find out that the ring is cursed and the Organization is getting closer and closer.

==Synopsis==
Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon must navigate the catacombs and get the cursed ring to a Huntik safehouse before thirty minutes pass or the Organization will manage to take control of the ring for evil purposes. While attempting to escape, Lok finds clues similar to those is in his father's journal.

== Plot ==
Sophie binds the Ring of Arc's curse with a Banebound spell, but the spell will only last about thirty minutes. The team has to get it to a Huntik Foundation specialist before the curse can harm anyone else Unfortunately, DeFoe has called on every Suit in Paris to block the exits from the catacombs so that he'll be sure to get the prize! Zhalia provides fake copies of the Ring using her disguise kit, and the group splits up having a ring each. Doing so improves their chances of escaping with the real Ring. While they each make their way, Lok finds a case with some archaeology tools while another locked case that Springer opens is found to have some kind of map.

Even with all their efforts, one by one, they're all captured. But all four members of Dante's group are revealed to have carried only fake rings. Then, Dante reveals that the real Ring of Arc was given to Gareon, who sneaked out of the catacombs invisibly. DeFoe retreats, and, back at Organization headquarters, the mysterious Rassimov tells him that the Professor is furious. DeFoe has beens suspended from his duties and is lucky to have not been "terminated" by the Professor yet. In Defoe's secret laboratory, he swears vengeance on Dante Vale in a fit of rage.

== Trivia ==
*Lok and Cherit discover the words "Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité" ("Liberty, Equality, Brotherhood"), France's national motto which found its origins in the French Revolution.
*The episode features a double foreshadowing: 
**While casting Banebound on the ring, Sophie suffers traumatic visions of past and future events. Those include include a scene of Zhalia punching her, which would occur in the episode "The Vampire Loses Its Fangs", and a scene of Sabriel's death, which would occur in the episode "The Mission".
**Sophie's visions are unknowingly inflicted on her by Arc, the Legendary Titan contained inside the ring, the existence of which will only be discovered in Season 2's episode "The Legendary Titan of Fate".
